description.purpose: The one store of a librarian: `entries`, one row per source of the space -- `path`, `dir`, `kind`, `fmt`, `oneline`, `tags` and `names` (JSON lists as text), `nodes`, the written `version` and the `announced` one, `changed_at`, `tomb` ('' or '1') -- and `pterms`/`nterms`, the path and the names cut into words. A full-text index over `pterms`, `nterms`, `oneline` and `tags` answers `find`.
description.use_when: Inside a librarian only; `./index` is its only writer, `./query` reads (`write_surface` internal).
description.not_in_scope: No content of a source, no history, no delete: a removed source stays a row with `tomb` '1'.
description.emits_meaning: One answer per message, a bundle answer for more than one operation.
description.consumes_meaning: One or more `tool_call` turns whose text is the JSON args of one store operation.
